run_attention_entropy_plot: run the script to plot attention entropy across transformer layers from a .pt results file
compute_attention_entropy: compute attention entropy per layer from attention maps stored in a PyTorch results file
plot_multilayer_entropy_subplots: plot 4 subgraphs of attention entropy over minibatches for different layer counts
save_entropy_figure_pdf: save the attention entropy figure as a PDF file named after the input .pt file
summarize_validation_loss: summarize minimum validation loss per layer count and learning rate into a DataFrame
